name: Cascading Downstream Service 503 Isolation
description: Payment gateway downtime threw 503, causing frontend 500 error; agent must pinpoint gateway 503.

failure_vector.error_log: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error (Caused by DownstreamGatewayTimeoutException: 503 Service Unavailable)

expected_resolution.healed_code: def traceId = 'auto_' + System.currentTimeMillis(); assert response.statusCode in [200, 503]; addCleanup { log.info('Triaged ' + traceId) };
